wf_1767698396606.name: Marker-based Metagenomic Strain Resolution Workflow
wf_1767698396606.description: A workflow for resolving microbial strains from metagenomic data using marker gene profiling and strain-level analysis tools.
use_cases: Identifying strain-level variation in gut microbiome samples
Tracking pathogenic strains in clinical metagenomic datasets
Comparative analysis of microbial communities across environments
natural_language_patterns: I want to resolve bacterial strains from my metagenomic data
How can I analyze strain-level differences using marker genes?
Find microbial strains in my sequencing data with profiling tools
Workflow for strain detection using MetaPhlAn and StrainPhlAn
Analyze metagenomes at the strain level

steps.description: Input raw metagenomic sequencing reads from a server directory.
Use BBMap to process and map reads, preparing them for quality control.
Filter and trim sequencing reads using BBDuk to remove adapters and low-quality bases.
Perform taxonomic profiling of the metagenomic sample using MetaPhlAn to identify microbial composition.
Conduct strain-level analysis using StrainPhlAn to resolve intra-species variants based on marker genes.
Output final strain-resolution results to a server folder for downstream analysis.

wf_1767701112167.name: TMS Workflow
wf_1767701112167.description: A bioinformatics workflow for metagenomic analysis that performs quality trimming, taxonomic profiling, and strain-level analysis using Trimmomatic, MetaPhlAn, and StrainPhlAn.
use_cases: Processing raw metagenomic sequencing data to assess microbial community composition
Identifying species and strain-level variants in microbiome samples
Preparing cleaned reads for downstream taxonomic and functional analysis
natural_language_patterns: I want to analyze my metagenomic data for species and strains
Run taxonomic and strain-level profiling on my raw reads
Process microbiome samples with quality control, classification, and strain analysis
Build a pipeline for metagenomic profiling using Trimmomatic and MetaPhlAn

steps.description: Input raw sequencing files from the server directory
Perform quality trimming of raw reads to remove adapters and low-quality bases
Conduct taxonomic profiling to determine microbial composition of the sample
Perform strain-level analysis to identify intra-species variants
Output results to a designated server folder

wf_1767701541155.name: BB-HUMAnN Workflow
wf_1767701541155.description: A bioinformatics workflow that processes metagenomic sequencing data using BBTools for quality control and HUMAnN for functional profiling.
use_cases: Removing host DNA from human microbiome samples
Preprocessing metagenomic reads for downstream analysis
Inferring microbial metabolic pathways from shotgun sequencing data
Generating gene family and pathway abundance profiles
natural_language_patterns: I want to analyze metagenomic data and get functional profiles
Remove host reads and do functional annotation
Process microbiome data with BBTools and HUMAnN
How can I go from raw metagenomic reads to pathway abundances?
Workflow for filtering and functional profiling of metagenomes

steps.description: Input raw sequencing data (e.g., FASTQ files) into the workflow.
Align reads to a reference genome (e.g., human, host) using BBMap to identify and remove host-derived sequences.
Perform quality trimming, adapter removal, and additional filtering of reads using BBduk.
Conduct functional profiling of filtered metagenomic reads using HUMAnN to infer gene families, pathways, and metabolic functions.
Output processed results (e.g., pathway abundances, gene tables) to a designated folder.

wf_1767702095290.name: BB-Kraken Workflow
wf_1767702095290.description: A bioinformatics workflow that processes raw sequencing reads using BBTools for quality control and alignment, followed by taxonomic classification with Kraken.
use_cases: Classifying microbial communities from environmental sequencing data
Filtering and trimming low-quality reads prior to analysis
Aligning reads to reference genomes for host contamination removal
Preparing metagenomic samples for downstream abundance profiling
natural_language_patterns: I want to classify species in my metagenomic sample
Process FASTQ reads with quality filtering and taxonomic assignment
Run Kraken on cleaned sequencing data
Use BBTools and Kraken for metagenome analysis
How do I go from raw reads to taxonomy labels?

steps.description: Input raw sequencing reads (e.g., FASTQ) from server storage.
Align reads to a reference using BBMap for initial processing or filtering.
Perform quality trimming, adapter removal, and filtering of reads using BBDuk.
Assign taxonomic labels to reads using Kraken with a k-mer based approach.
Save classified output to a designated folder on the server.

wf_1767705215217.name: TH Workflow
wf_1767705215217.description: A bioinformatics workflow that processes raw sequencing reads by trimming adapters and removing host contamination, followed by functional profiling of microbial communities using HUMAnN.
use_cases: Functional analysis of microbiome samples from human or environmental sources
Removal of host-derived contamination in metagenomic datasets
Preprocessing and metabolic pathway inference from raw FASTQ reads
natural_language_patterns: I want to analyze microbial function from my metagenomic reads
Process raw sequencing data to remove adapters and host contamination, then run functional profiling
Use Trimmomatic and HUMAnN in a pipeline for microbiome analysis
Trim reads and perform pathway-level analysis on metagenomes

steps.description: Input raw sequencing data (e.g., FASTQ files) into the workflow.
Trim adapters, low-quality bases, and filter reads using Trimmomatic.
Perform functional profiling of trimmed reads using HUMAnN to infer metabolic pathways and gene families.
Output processed results to a designated server folder for storage or further analysis.
